about: WEB4b (B1f's 'left for a later session', 19 Nov 2026): on staging «لبن» found Halloum AK-0044, because the search-words job (version auto-2026-11-16) wrote 'Liban Lait' as its brand («لبن ليت», «ليبن ليت», 'Liban Lait', 'liban lait'); Halloum's brand is Leentaanayel. brand_word_collisions(), run on staging read only, found three more brand words that are another item's kind word: «ماي سترو» on Maestro tea AK-0143 («ماي», water), 'tanour al asir' on Tannour bread AK-0088 ('asir', juice), 'indomie mee' on Indomie noodles AK-0174 ('mee', water). The staging rows are written into the test database through save_search_words (the job's own door) after the seeds, as on staging. Run by test/db/web4b-brand-words.test.ts on find_products (the chat's search) and web_catalog_search (the website).
